aboutGame.title: What is The Conjuring Unspoken?
paragraphs: The Conjuring Unspoken is a first-person supernatural horror experience built around investigation, atmosphere, and teamwork. You explore haunted locations, gather evidence with a toolkit of detection and capture devices, and try to resolve the haunting while an unseen entity reacts to every light, sound, and mistake you make.

Runs follow a four-phase loop: scout the site, document evidence, survive the escalation, and extract before attention peaks. Fear, sanity, and entity attention are layered pressures that feed each other, so patience and information matter more than speed. Our wiki covers the full system, from beginner steps and control bindings to investigation tools, story choices, characters, secrets, and release information.

modules.name: The Conjuring Unspoken Beginner Guide
modules.description: A beginner-friendly guide covering the basic gameplay loop, investigation process, story choices, and how to start your paranormal investigation. It helps new players understand controls, objectives, and important mechanics before playing.

highlights.detail: Set your audio first — headphones on, effects high; sound is your primary warning system
Finish the opening tutorial without skipping to learn movement, interaction, and item rules
Walk the full map once in a low-pressure state and memorize exits and hiding spots
Practice one tool or mechanic per run instead of overloading yourself
Join your first real round with a patient, talking group
Review what killed you after every run — deaths are information, not failure

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about The Conjuring Unspoken.

items.question: What is The Conjuring Unspoken?
items.answer: The Conjuring Unspoken is a first-person supernatural horror experience built around paranormal investigation, atmosphere, and teamwork. You explore haunted locations, gather evidence with detection and capture tools, and try to resolve the haunting while an unseen entity reacts to your light, noise, and movement.

items.question: Is The Conjuring Unspoken beginner friendly?
items.answer: Reasonably so, as long as you treat it as something to learn rather than a challenge to beat. The systems are straightforward and the difficulty comes from pressure: set your audio first, walk instead of sprinting, and give yourself a few runs to absorb the map and audio cues.

items.question: Can you play The Conjuring Unspoken solo?
items.answer: Yes. Solo runs are tenser and less forgiving because no one can cover your retreat or revive you, so patience and escape planning matter even more. For new players, a duo is usually the sweet spot.

items.question: What tools do you use in The Conjuring Unspoken?
items.answer: The core kit includes an EMF reader, thermometer, spirit box, spirit writing, motion sensors, camera and DVR, salt lines, and a crucifix. Each device reads a different phenomenon, so never carry two tools that do the same job.

items.question: How do you survive a hunt in The Conjuring Unspoken?
items.answer: Break line of sight, stop sprinting so your stamina can recover, and listen for the pre-hunt sound set. Place wards and salt on your escape route before you start working, not in a panic during a chase.

items.question: Where can I watch or play The Conjuring Unspoken?
items.answer: Platform availability is still community-reported. Conjuring titles typically follow a theatrical-first pattern before moving to digital rental, subscription streaming, and physical media, and regional catalogs differ enormously.
